subject: Mutual On‑Ramp Plan for SummitCare — roles & 6‑week timeline
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@summitcare.health>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@summitcare.health>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual On‑Ramp Plan for SummitCare — roles & 6‑week timeline

Hi Elena & Raj,

Great to meet you both last week — thanks again for the time. As discussed, I put together a short mutual action plan (attached) that lays out a pragmatic 6‑week evaluation and close timeline so we can get you from POC to production with predictable latency/cost targets.

High level:
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for clinical-document summarization at 95th %-tile latency <= 220ms and token cost target <= $0.0009/token for steady state.
- Timeline: 6 weeks (week-by-week milestones on tab 2 of the attached MAP).
- Success criteria: sample eval prompts + latency/throughput tests + security signoff.

Please confirm the internal champions for each lane below so we can lock responsibilities in the MAP:
- Product/champion (technical lead) — you listed Elena, correct?
- Security & compliance — procurement / security reviewer (who should I loop in?)
- Procurement / legal — Raj for contract questions?
- Customer success / onboarding — we’ll involve our CS lead to coordinate test data and runbooks.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm internal champions and any calendar constraints by Wed 10/20.
2) We schedule a 30‑minute MAP alignment call (propose Wed 10/27 or Thu 10/28).
3) I’ll send an updated MAP that includes any changes and the initial eval prompt set.

Attachments: SummitCare_MAP_v1.0.xlsx (MAP w/ milestones), SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (initial SOC2 checklist you asked about).

If those dates look tight, tell me which week is better and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

From: Elena Morales <elena@summitcare.health>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@summitcare.health>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 11:05:24 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual On‑Ramp Plan for SummitCare — roles & 6‑week timeline

Thanks Connor — appreciate the clear plan and the workbook. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Confirming I’m the product champion and will own the sample prompts and validation criteria.
- Security will be led by our InfoSec manager, Priya Desai (priya.desai@summitcare.health) — looping her on procurement thread shortly.
- Raj is our procurement lead; he’ll handle contracts but wants legal to review any SLA language before sign.

One ask: can we shift the start by one week? Our clinical team is in a software freeze next week; starting the week of 10/26 would work better. If you can update the MAP to reflect a 6‑week window starting 10/26, that would be ideal.

Attaching a short internal requirements note (SummitCare_eval_requirements.docx) with the clinical data subsets we want to include in the POC.

Happy to jump on the alignment call — 10/27 afternoon PT works for me.

Best,
Elena
Director of Product, Clinical Systems
SummitCare Health

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@summitcare.health>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@summitcare.health>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:30:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual On‑Ramp Plan for SummitCare — roles & 6‑week timeline

Thanks Elena — perfect, and that shift is fine. I updated the attached MAP to start the week of 10/26 and mapped out owners next to each milestone. Key updates in v1.1:
- Start date moved to 10/26; completion target 12/07.
- Added Priya Desai as Security reviewer and Raj as Procurement owner.
- Included a short eval prompt set (tab 3) and acceptance thresholds.

On the alignment call:
- Agenda (30 min): introductions, milestone walkthrough, data access plan, immediate blockers.
- Proposed times: Wed 10/27 2:00–2:30 PM PT or Thu 10/28 10:00–10:30 AM PT.

Action items for this week:
- Elena: confirm final list of sample datasets (thanks for sending the doc).
- Raj: share any standard procurement terms or timing constraints.
- Priya: confirm evidence you need from our SOC2 pack (I attached the checklist earlier).
- Neha & Grace (CC'd): I’ve asked CS to prepare the onboarding runbook and evaluation harness.

Quoted for context:
> On Sun, Oct 18, 2026 at 11:05 AM Elena Morales <elena@summitcare.health> wrote:
>
> Thanks Connor — appreciate the clear plan and the workbook. Quick clarifications from our side:
> - Confirming I’m the product champion and will own the sample prompts and validation criteria.
> - Security will be led by our InfoSec manager, Priya Desai (priya.desai@summitcare.health) — looping her on procurement thread shortly.
> - Raj is our procurement lead; he’ll handle contracts but wants legal to review any SLA language before sign.
>
See attached: SummitCare_MAP_v1.1.xlsx

Connor

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@summitcare.health>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@summitcare.health>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 14:03:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual On‑Ramp Plan for SummitCare — roles & 6‑week timeline

Hi all — Neha from Customer Success here. Thanks for looping us in Connor. Quick notes from the CS side:

- We’ll own the evaluation harness and run the token/latency tests with your clinical samples.
- Need data access details (S3 path or secure upload) and a contact for redaction rules (Elena, if your clinical team can point us to the owner that would help).
- Pre-demo checklist:
  * Test account + API key (we’ll provide a scoped key for the POC)
  * Sample data ingestion (CSV/NDJSON)
  * Acceptance prompt set (Connor — Elena to confirm)

I’ll schedule a 30‑minute kickoff for Wed 10/27 at 2:00 PM PT (proposed) and send a calendar invite once Elena confirms.

Attachments we’ll bring to the sync: onboarding_runbook.pdf (short runbook), eval-harness-instructions.md (attachment stub).

Looking forward — we’ll make the first week very light (sanity checks only) and then ramp tests in week 2.

Neha Kapoor
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199
